class.name: IfcEllipse
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-42:1992 : An ellipse ( IfcEllipse ) is a conic section defined by the lengths of the semi-major and semi-minor diameters and the position (center or mid point of the line joining the foci) and orientation of the curve. Interpretation of the data shall be as follows: C = SELF\IfcConic.Position.Location x = SELF\IfcConic.Position.P[1] y = SELF\IfcConic.Position.P[2] z =
